question: Can prior species x physical-site acoustic history, combined with persistence of the focal dry state, reproduce the observed rainfall-associated four-component matrix allocation?

population.physical_stability: Retain only pairs with identical nonmissing SiteID at all ten focal StopNumbers.
population.prior_history: Require at least one eligible run in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum strictly before the earlier focal-pair year that sampled at least 8 of the 10 focal SiteIDs.
population.minimum_gate: >=1500 pairs and >=300 routes before any null endpoint is read.

historical_probability.species_support: Use the frozen full stratum species pool from the existing uniform-null machinery only as support; focal wet outcomes do not enter historical probabilities.
historical_probability.physical_site_exposure: For each focal current SiteID, count only strictly prior eligible runs in which that exact SiteID was sampled.
historical_probability.cell_frequency: Prior detections / prior SiteID exposures for each species x focal SiteID.
historical_probability.smoothing: Use kappa=2 hierarchical shrinkage, mirroring the existing uniform-null smoothing: species means shrink to a stratum-wide prior mean, then cell frequencies shrink to the species mean.

focal_persistence.construction: p_anchor=(1-a)*p_prior + a*dry_cell_state before the common magnitude-matching shift.
focal_persistence.rationale: Same fixed persistence strength as the existing primary persistence-preserving stress-test null.

magnitude_matching: For each pair solve one common logit shift so expected wet incidence equals observed wet incidence count.
primary_test: Four-component rain-contrast beta vector (corner, spatial spread, taxonomic deepening, within-core) with the same Mahalanobis plus-one Monte Carlo omnibus used by the existing nulls.

identity_controls.purpose: Distinguish specific physical-site memory from generic extra heterogeneity.
identity_controls.construction: Within each focal pair, deterministically permute the ten historical SiteID probability columns while leaving species probabilities, dry state, wet incidence magnitude and route geometry unchanged.

prefixed_interpretation.site_identity_specific: True-memory P>=0.05 AND both identity-permuted control P<0.05.
prefixed_interpretation.generic_history_heterogeneity: True-memory P>=0.05 AND at least one identity-permuted control P>=0.05.

boundaries: Failure to reject means sufficiency under this null family, not proof of the biological mechanism.
Prior acoustic history can encode persistent habitat suitability, local population recurrence, observer-access geometry or other stable site properties.
The stratum species pool is used as support only and can include taxa first documented later; all probability weights are strictly prior-only.
No individual movement, continuous occupancy, reproductive success or causal rainfall claim is authorized.
No RC11 submission change is authorized.
